Message.Name: Logon
Message.Description: Initiates a FIX session with the NASDAQ Options (NOM) order entry gateway. Encryption not supported. First message of the session; no further messages until NASDAQ verifies the SenderCompID.

Field.Name: EncryptMethod
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: HeartBtInt
Field.Description: Heartbeat interval in seconds.

Field.Name: ResetSeqNumFlag
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: RawDataLength
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: RawData
Field.Description: Not supported.

Message.Name: NewOrderSingle
Message.Description: Submits a new options order to NASDAQ for execution. New Order messages received with a duplicate ClOrdID are ignored regardless of PossResend.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by institution. Up to 20 characters.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If provided, must be 1 (Automated execution order, private, no Broker intervention).

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1-6 character options root symbol. Spaces, periods, commas not allowed.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts. 1 to 999999. No commas, decimals, spaces, or negatives.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required for Limit orders. 1-10 character decimal price.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Firm identification. Must be a valid exchange-assigned mnemonic of an approved member. Defaults to the FIX port's mnemonic if absent.

Field.Name: ExecBroker
Field.Description: Routing strategy or special handling instruction. Defaults to the firm's configured execBroker if absent or unrecognized.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Up to 32 characters.

Field.Name: SettlmntTyp
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: FutSettDate
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Can contain only one instruction. f ISO; G AON (AON with a non-IOC TIF is treated as IOC).

Field.Name: DisplayInst
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Supported, but orders with a MinQty may not rest on the book; specify IOC (59=3) or it is converted to IOC.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Time-in-force. Absence interpreted as Immediate or Cancel.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Order capacity. Defaults to C (Customer order).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Optional clearing data sent to OCC. NASDAQ uses up to 13 characters as a supplementary ID.

Field.Name: ExpireTime
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Open or close position indicator.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: If provided, must be OPT (options).

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Expiration date YYYYMM. Required unless MaturityDate is specified; must match it if both present.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Expiration day of month DD. Required unless MaturityDate is specified; must match it if both present.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Maturity YYYYMMDD. Required unless MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay are specified.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 put, 1 call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price. 0 to 999999.99999999.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Up to 5-character alphanumeric passed to the OCC sub-account field (Badge # / Market Maker ID). Left-most 4 forwarded to OCC. Required if Rule80A is M or O.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange where the Market Maker is registered (used when Rule80A is O). Defaults to Q for NOM.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA number (clearing firm), up to 5-character numeric. If absent, the order is not a CMTA.

Field.Name: CrossTradeFlag
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: Exchange internal firm identifier of the Directed Participant for Directed Order Flow. Up to 4 characters. NOM only.

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: Auction type this order responds to. P = PRISM Cross. If the auction is active the order may join it; otherwise it is cancelled. NOM only.

Field.Name: AuctionID
Field.Description: Numeric auction id to join. 0 (or absent) joins the ongoing auction of the specified AuctionType. NOM only.

Message.Name: NewOrderList
Message.Description: PRISM Cross. A list of exactly 2 orders, each a full order definition with its own ClOrdID, representing the agency and initiating sides. Both sides specify the same quantity and must lock or cross. NOM only.

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: P = PRISM Cross. Required.

Field.Name: NWTOrdType
Field.Description: No Worse Than order type for the initiating order. 1 MKT, 2 LIMIT. Required; must match or improve the initiating order's Price/OrdType.

Field.Name: NWTPrice
Field.Description: No Worse Than limit price (up to 4 decimals). Required if NWTOrdType is 2 (Limit); must be omitted otherwise.

Field.Name: CrossSurrender
Field.Description: Y surrenders the agency order to other participants. Invalid with NWT price and MKT orders. Defaults to Do Not Surrender.

Field.Name: NoOrders
Field.Description: Number of orders in the list. Always 2.

Field.Name: ListSeqNo
Field.Description: Order number within the list. Denotes the start of each order definition in the list.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the order as assigned by institution. Up to 20 characters.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If provided, must be 1.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1-6 character options root symbol.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts. Both sides must specify the same quantity.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required for Limit orders.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Firm identification.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: Up to 32 characters.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: G AON (optional on agency side, invalid on initiating); f ISO (optional on either side).

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: 0 DAY, 1 GTC, 3 IOC. All are converted to IOC before processing; other values are rejected.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Order capacity. Defaults to C (Customer order).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Optional clearing data sent to OCC (up to 13 characters).

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Open or close position indicator.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: If provided, must be OPT.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Expiration YYYYMM. Required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Expiration day DD. Required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Maturity YYYYMMDD. Required unless MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay are specified.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 put, 1 call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price. 0 to 999999.99999999.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Up to 5-character alphanumeric passed to OCC. Required if Rule80A is M or O.

Field.Name: SecurityExchange
Field.Description: Exchange where the Market Maker is registered (used when Rule80A is O). Defaults to Q for NOM.

Field.Name: ClearingFirm
Field.Description: CMTA number, up to 5-character numeric.

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: Directed Participant identifier. Processed only for the agency order; ignored for the initiating order.

Message.Name: OrderCancelRequest
Message.Description: Requests cancellation of all remaining quantity of an existing order. Accepted only if the order can be pulled back without executing. PRISM Cross orders can never be cancelled.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the original order to cancel.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of cancel request. Up to 20 characters.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1-6 character options root symbol.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Required. CashOrderQty not supported.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of most recent order as assigned by broker.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Firm identification.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Expiration YYYYMM. Required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Expiration day DD. Required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Maturity YYYYMMDD. Required unless MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay are specified.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 put, 1 call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price.

Message.Name: OrderCancelReplaceRequest
Message.Description: Order Modification Request. Only price, quantity, TIF, order type, Account ID, and AllocAccount may change. For PRISM Cross only the initiating order's order type, price, NWT order type, and NWT price can change.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID of the original order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of replacement order. Up to 20 characters.

Field.Name: HandlInst
Field.Description: If provided, must be 1.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1-6 character options root symbol.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Must match original side.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Required. CashOrderQty not supported.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Required for Limit orders.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of most recent order as assigned by broker.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Firm identification.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: Not supported. ExecInst of the original order carries through.

Field.Name: DisplayInst
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: If absent, original TIF carries through. Allowed changes: DAY to GTC/IOC, GTC to DAY/IOC, IOC to DAY/GTC.

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Capacity of the original order carries through to all replacements.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: If provided, used after replace; otherwise the original account carries through.

Field.Name: MinQty
Field.Description: Not supported. MinQty of the original order carries through.

Field.Name: MaxFloor
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: If provided, must be OPT.

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Expiration YYYYMM. Required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Expiration day DD. Required unless MaturityDate is specified.

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Maturity YYYYMMDD. Required unless MaturityMonthYear and MaturityDay are specified.

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 put, 1 call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price.

Field.Name: AllocAccount
Field.Description: Directed Participant identifier. Up to 4 characters. NOM only.

Field.Name: NWTOrdType
Field.Description: No Worse Than order type for a PRISM Cross initiating order. 1 MKT, 2 LIMIT. NOM only.

Field.Name: NWTPrice
Field.Description: No Worse Than limit price for the initiating order. Required if NWTOrdType is 2. NOM only.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Assigned by NASDAQ. Unique per chain of orders.

Field.Name: ExecID
Field.Description: Unique identifier of the execution message (e.g. Trade ID). Unique within a trading day per firm mnemonic. Up to 36 characters.

Field.Name: ExecTransType
Field.Description: Transaction type. 0 New, 1 Cancel, 3 Status (OrdStatus 3 Done For Day).

Field.Name: ExecType
Field.Description: Type of execution report.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: Current state of the chain of orders.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: 1-6 character options root symbol.

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Side of the order.

Field.Name: OrderQty
Field.Description: Number of contracts.

Field.Name: LeavesQty
Field.Description: Contracts open for further execution. 0 when the order is no longer active, otherwise OrderQty minus CumQty.

Field.Name: CumQty
Field.Description: Currently executed contracts for the chain of orders.

Field.Name: AvgPx
Field.Description: Always 0.

Field.Name: Account
Field.Description: As specified in the new order.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: As specified in the new order.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: As specified in the new order.

Field.Name: ExecInst
Field.Description: f ISO; G AON.

Field.Name: DisplayInst
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: TradeDate
Field.Description: Used when reporting other than current day trades.

Field.Name: TimeInForce
Field.Description: Absence indicates Immediate or Cancel order.

Field.Name: OrdType
Field.Description: Order type.

Field.Name: TransactTime
Field.Description: Time of execution / order creation (UTC).

Field.Name: Rule80A
Field.Description: Capacity from the original order.

Field.Name: LiquidityFlag
Field.Description: Returned within execution reports containing a partial or full fill.

Field.Name: OpenClose
Field.Description: Open or close position indicator.

Field.Name: SecurityType
Field.Description: OPT (options).

Field.Name: MaturityMonthYear
Field.Description: Expiration YYYYMM. Absent when ExecType is 8 (Rejected).

Field.Name: MaturityDay
Field.Description: Expiration day DD. Absent when ExecType is 8 (Rejected).

Field.Name: MaturityDate
Field.Description: Maturity YYYYMMDD. Absent when ExecType is 8 (Rejected).

Field.Name: PutOrCall
Field.Description: 0 put, 1 call.

Field.Name: StrikePrice
Field.Description: Strike price.

Field.Name: AuctionType
Field.Description: P = PRISM Cross. NOM only.

Field.Name: NWTOrdType
Field.Description: Present in all PRISM Cross responses. 1 MKT, 2 LIMIT. NOM only.

Field.Name: NWTPrice
Field.Description: Present in PRISM Cross responses with NWTOrdType 2 (Limit). NOM only.

Field.Name: CrossSurrender
Field.Description: Present if specified in the original PRISM Cross order. NOM only.

Field.Name: ClearingAccount
Field.Description: Present if provided in the original order or order list message.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Contracts bought/sold on this last fill. 0 for non-fills.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this last fill. 0 for non-fills.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: MPID. First field in repeating group. Required if NoContraBrokers > 0. This field will be present in the message if the OrdStatus = 1 or 2. For exchange-listed securities: 4-char MPID or 4-char exchange Exchange Values: American Stock Exchange = AMEX Boston Stock Exchange = BOSX Cincinnati Stock Exchange = CINN Chicago Stock Exchange = XMSE International Stock Exchage = INSE New York Stock Exchang

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Number of ContraBrokers repeating group instances. This field will be present in the message if the OrdStatus = 1 or 2.

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrdStatus of Partial or Filled.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Contracts bought/sold on this last fill. 0 for non-fills.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this last fill. 0 for non-fills.

Field.Name: ContraBroker
Field.Description: MPID. First field in repeating group. Required if NoContraBrokers > 0. This field will be present in the message if the OrdStatus = 1 or 2. For exchange-listed securities: 4-char MPID or 4-char exchange Exchange Values: American Stock Exchange = AMEX Boston Stock Exchange = BOSX Cincinnati Stock Exchange = CINN Chicago Stock Exchange = XMSE International Stock Exchage = INSE New York Stock Exchang

Field.Name: NoContraBrokers
Field.Description: Number of ContraBrokers repeating group instances. This field will be present in the message if the OrdStatus = 1 or 2.

Field.Name: LastLiquidityInd
Field.Description: Indicator to identify whether this fill was a result of a liquidity provider providing or liquidity taker taking the liquidity. Applicable only for OrdStatus of Partial or Filled.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Required when responding to a cancel or cancel/replace (ExecType Pending Cancel, Replaced, or Cancelled).

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: Required when responding to a cancel or cancel/replace (ExecType Pending Cancel, Replaced, or Cancelled).

Field.Name: OrdRejReason
Field.Description: Code to identify reason for order rejection. Valid values: 0 = Broker option 1 = Unknown symbol 2 = Exchange closed 3 = Order exceeds limit 4 = Too late to enter 5 = Unknown Order 6 = Duplicate Order (e.g. dupe ClOrdID) 7 = Duplicate of a verbally communicated order 8 = Stale Order

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Free format text.

Field.Name: ExecRefID
Field.Description: Not supported.

Field.Name: LastShares
Field.Description: Contracts bought/sold on this last fill. 0 for non-fills.

Field.Name: LastPx
Field.Description: Price of this last fill. 0 for non-fills.

Message.Name: OrderCancelReject
Message.Description: Issued upon receipt of a Cancel Request or Cancel/Replace Request that cannot be honored.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: "Unknown" for unknown orders; otherwise the OrderID of the last order in the chain.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique order ID assigned by broker to the cancel request or replacement order.

Field.Name: OrigClOrdID
Field.Description: ClOrdID that could not be cancelled/replaced.

Field.Name: OrdStatus
Field.Description: OrdStatus value after this cancel reject is applied.

Field.Name: CxlRejReason
Field.Description: Reason for cancel rejection.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: See Cancel Reject Reasons.

Field.Name: CxlRejResponseTo
Field.Description: Type of request the reject is in response to. 1 Order Cancel Request, 2 Order Cancel/Replace Request.

Message.Name: OrderMassCancelRequest
Message.Description: Purge/Reset request from a firm configured for risk protection. A Reset is required after receiving a RapidFire notification.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: Valid NASDAQ MPID / firm mnemonic. Defaults to the port's mnemonic if absent.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Unique ID of the Purge/Reset request. Must be unique for the trading session.

Field.Name: UnderlyingSymbol
Field.Description: Underlying symbol to purge or reset.

Field.Name: RequestType
Field.Description: Purge/Reset type. 8 Reset, 2 Purge.

Message.Name: OrderMassCancelReport
Message.Description: Notifies firms when Rapid Fire Risk Protection triggers in an underlying or when Kill-Switch is applied/reset, and responds to purge or reset requests.

Field.Name: ClientID
Field.Description: NASDAQ MPID / firm mnemonic. Absent for Kill-Switch notifications.

Field.Name: OrderID
Field.Description: Exchange-assigned unique identifier of the notification for the session. Blank if the request was rejected (531=0). For Kill-Switch, formatted PORT-Firm-Trigger.

Field.Name: ClOrdID
Field.Description: Present if this responds to a purge or reset request from the firm.

Field.Name: RequestType
Field.Description: Present for purge/reset responses or Kill-Switch notifications. 8 Reset, 2 Purge.

Field.Name: Response
Field.Description: Response/notification code.

Field.Name: RejectReason
Field.Description: Present if Response is 0 (rejected).

Field.Name: UnderlyingSymbol
Field.Description: Underlying that was purged/reset or rapid fired. Omitted for a firm-level purge across all underlyings.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: Additional information about this message.

Field.Name: BeginString
Field.Description: FIX.4.0, FIX.4.1, or FIX.4.2. Always the first field.

Field.Name: BodyLength
Field.Description: Always the second field.

Field.Name: MsgType
Field.Description: Always the third field.

Field.Name: MsgSeqNum
Field.Description: Sequence number.

Field.Name: SenderCompID
Field.Description: As assigned by NASDAQ. 4 to 6 characters. Returned as NSDQ on outbound messages.

Field.Name: TargetCompID
Field.Description: Always NSDQ.

Field.Name: SendingTime
Field.Description: Sending time.

Field.Name: SenderSubID
Field.Description: 32 characters or less.

Field.Name: TargetSubID
Field.Description: Ignored.

Field.Name: PossDupFlag
Field.Description: Always required for retransmitted messages.

Field.Name: PossResend
Field.Description: Required when the message may be a duplicate of another sent under a different sequence number.

Field.Name: OrigSendingTime
Field.Description: Required for resends. Same value as SendingTime if data is unavailable.

Field.Name: CheckSum
Field.Description: Standard FIX checksum.

Other Exchange Registered Market Maker Order

Post Only - DAY limit maker order, never a taker (NOM only)
